title: [3.1.0] [master or dev] Error "Wrong pump device" on virtual pump after restart
symptom: After restarting AAPS, when using a virtual pump, giving insulin or using the calculator results in an error 'Wrong pump device' and an empty progress bar. The error message fills the screen and may truncate the graph. The insulin injection is not saved to database or Nightscout when the error occurs.
cause: The thread identifies this as a bug in the Java code, not a configuration issue. The error is caused by a bug in the app's code, as stated by a user and confirmed by the maintainer's fix commit.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit (3f3cdde53bcff139515cf9cdfb9bb5dbd68a4ca2) in the AndroidAPS repository. No specific user-facing fix is described; the resolution is a code fix.
